title: Phone: Millbrook Courier — has the City been hacked?

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Reporter, Millbrook Courier
transcript.text: Hi, Dana Whitfield, Millbrook Courier. Online bill pay is down, City Hall’s phones are ringing out and a council member just posted that the City has been hacked.

transcript.speaker: Reporter, Millbrook Courier
transcript.text: Has it? Is the water plant affected? I’m filing for the noon web edition.

instructorNote: First press call, 22 minutes in. Watch for the holding statement and for the PIO not confirming a ransom or a cause.

snapshot.title: Phone Call: Customer Reports No Water in Zone 3

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: This is Margaret Gable from Hilltop Estates, Zone 3. I’ve had no water for 40 minutes. The pressure is almost gone. I can’t even flush the toilet. I saw the AMI map on my phone, but it’s blank. Is the plant okay?

transcript.speaker: Callee
transcript.text: Ms. Gable, thank you for calling. We’re aware of a technical issue affecting Zone 3. We’re investigating and will share updates as soon as possible. Please stay on the line so we can log your location.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: I just want to know if it’s safe to drink. The water’s not coming back at all.

snapshot.instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The customer’s report is valid but not yet actionable—no data loss in the lab, no lab failure yet.
